description: Legacy SlateDB run-catalog markers carry a start-date segment: runs/_index/by-start/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<ulid> (5 NUL-separated segments, date from RunId::key_segments()). Upstream v0.342 parse_run_catalog_key initially accepted only the 4-segment canonical form and its import tests seed only that synthetic layout via a #[cfg(test)] helper — real production data failed the fail-closed SQLite run-history activation at boot. Any future SlateDB key parser must be tested against the REAL writer layout (Record/Repository key_for_id + key_segments), not a hand-written canonical form.
resolution: Accept both layouts in the parser (31809f2ad): date segment validated strictly as chrono NaiveDate %Y-%m-%d, run id stays the final segment, everything else rejects; run_catalog_key_legacy test helper reproduces the writer layout byte-exactly; regression test proves date-prefixed markers import and count. Deployed activation completed on real data (75 runs / 42163 events).
